This weekend, briefing for anyone with a companion animal
Please give it some attention
Travelers with pets must review the latest guidance before departure.

Companion Animal Travel Desk

Please confirm that every carrier, leash, and document is ready for inspection. Staff will answer questions in a warm and professional manner and will give patient attention to each animal. Travelers should also keep their plans clear and their communication respectful so the process stays smooth for everyone involved.

Aurelia Skyways asks all travelers to follow crew instructions and to share any concern early. This helps the department support safe handling, orderly boarding, and calm travel conditions for companion animals. If your animal needs special care, please raise the matter promptly so the team can advise you in plain words and direct you to the right support.

For help with any pet travel matter, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
